Optional hardware-backed request signing. Requires HTTPS, a supported device and a server that explicitly trusts this independent app’s package and signing certificate. Does not unlock AI by itself. After a server restart, register again manually; failed AI requests are never automatically repeated.

Generate a non-exportable Android Keystore key and send its attestation certificate chain to your current server? Certificates disclose application and device security information. No books, photos or AI prompts are sent and no provider is called. Software keys and development registrations are not accepted. Existing server policy is not changed.
